verdicts.reason: A: the dark header band floats under an empty cream strip, the eyebrow is crammed into the header, and the body copy and CTA sit left of the centred headline, so the layout has no shared axis; the gaps around the body are also large and uneven. B: keeps a full-bleed header and a consistent centred axis, but the divider now sits above the eyebrow instead of under the headline, the vertical gaps between headline, body and CTA are oversized and uneven, and the legal line is microscopic.
